description: Utloppspunkter dagvatten - Öppna Data is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stockholm Vatten och Avfall. Stockholm Water and Waste outlet points from the storm water network. Point objects for those places where there are storm water outlets from Stockholm Water and Waste's storm water network. Coverage: Stockholm Vatten och Avfall. The portal shows the English title as "Drainage points stormwater - Open Data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stockholm Vatten och Avfall. Its keywords include Extern dataportal, Miljö, Sjöar och vattendrag, Stockholm Vatten och Avfall, Fullständiga metadata. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, HTML, WFS. The listing shows 2022-10-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
